lead: Politics is dominated by a sharp government–PTI exchange over militancy in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, with PTI's Islamabad march now pushed back to 4 October. Security operations continue in Balochistan, markets slipped as oil climbed on US–Iran tensions, and heavy rain snarled the twin cities.

stories.headline: PTI pushes Islamabad long march back to 4 October
stories.summary: The opposition party has postponed its march on the capital, originally planned for 27 September, by one week.

stories.headline: Ministers accuse PTI of going soft on Afghanistan-based militants
stories.summary: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry criticised the PTI-led Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government's stance on militancy, with one minister saying the party must choose between Pakistan and Afghanistan.

stories.headline: Polling ends in Bahawalpur's NA-168 by-election
stories.summary: Voting closed in the National Assembly seat left vacant by a lawmaker's death; his son is standing for the PML-N.

stories.headline: SCO coordinators meet in Islamabad under Pakistan's chairmanship
stories.summary: National coordinators of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation are meeting from 28 to 30 September to review the bloc's work programme.

stories.headline: Over 70 militants killed in Balochistan in four days, says ISPR
stories.summary: The military's media wing reported operations across several districts of the province since Thursday.

stories.headline: Three traffic police officers killed in attack in Tank
stories.summary: Gunmen opened fire on a mobile police van in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa district; the stolen vehicle was later recovered.

stories.headline: AJK police arrest 122 after violent unrest
stories.summary: Arrests follow attacks that injured security personnel and damaged property in Azad Jammu and Kashmir.

stories.headline: Islamabad rejects Afghan Taliban claims over Nuristan violence
stories.summary: The information ministry dismissed allegations linking Pakistan to reported violence in Afghanistan's Nuristan province.

stories.headline: New Hangor-class submarine test-fires weapons in Arabian Sea
stories.summary: The navy's newly inducted submarine carried out its first live firing, including anti-ship missiles, according to ISPR.

stories.headline: PSX falls nearly 500 points on broad selling
stories.summary: The benchmark index dropped as selling pressure spread across the market.

stories.headline: Petrol subsidy likely to run for another 10 months
stories.summary: The government is expected to keep its fuel relief scheme in place.

stories.headline: No state money or sovereign guarantees for new PIA aircraft
stories.summary: An adviser to the finance ministry said the government will help the airline secure private international financing instead.

stories.headline: Oil climbs as US–Iran talks stall
stories.summary: Brent crude rose while negotiations remained deadlocked — a pressure point for Pakistan's import bill.

stories.headline: Heavy rain disrupts traffic and flights in twin cities
stories.summary: Downpours brought congestion to major routes in Islamabad and Rawalpindi and affected flight operations.

stories.headline: Iran says it wants peace but will confront aggression
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's warning came as US President Donald Trump signalled possible talks this week.

stories.headline: Floods and landslides kill dozens in India and Nepal
stories.summary: At least 56 people died in Uttar Pradesh and 12 in Nepal over three days of heavy rain.

stories.headline: Pakistan into Asian Games cricket semi-final
stories.summary: Rain washed out the quarter-final against Hong Kong, sending Pakistan through.

stories.headline: Volleyball side beat Kazakhstan in Asian Games opener
stories.summary: Pakistan recovered from losing a set to win their first Pool A match.
